previous_verdict.finding: OpenAI SDK Pydantic ValidationError escaped the production transport before the initial-plus-two app retry loop.

plan.scopeReviewed: Full T3 acceptance/QA and the T11-only real-cloud boundary were reread; no real cloud traffic was required.

fixAssessment.productionPath: OpenAIResponsesTransport.execute catches pydantic.ValidationError raised by AsyncOpenAI.responses.parse and returns the canonical invalid JSON object string {}.
fixAssessment.canonicalConsumption: main.parse_model_output passes {} to RecipeGenerateResponse.model_validate_json, catches the resulting Pydantic ValidationError, and performs exactly three total attempts before ModelValidationFailed maps to typed HTTP 422.
fixAssessment.repair: When the first two responses.parse calls raise Pydantic ValidationError and the third returns a valid parsed model, the same loop returns HTTP 200 with exactly three recipes and performs no fourth call.
fixAssessment.exceptionNarrowness: No broad exception was introduced. APIError is still translated to OpenAIUpstreamError and typed 502 without retry. A TypeError from responses.parse still escapes as HTTP 500 after one call, proving programmer errors are not converted into schema-invalid retries.
fixAssessment.providerControls: Live production-transport-shaped state observed model=gpt-5.6, store=false, text_format=RecipeGenerateResponse, injection text present in input and absent from instructions.

adversarialMatrix.malformed_input: IN: live malformed request returned typed 422 with zero model calls; provider schema-invalid exhaustion returned typed 422 after exactly three calls.
adversarialMatrix.prompt_injection: IN: injection-like notes crossed the real transport as input only, never instructions; model, text format, and store=false were unchanged.
adversarialMatrix.stale_state: IN: mode resets showed zero calls, exhaustion and repair each ended at exactly three, and quota UTC/counter tests remained green.
adversarialMatrix.dirty_worktree: IN: HEAD was pinned to e69a3d4. Concurrent task-4 files under android/** and task-4-* evidence were out of scope and left untouched.
adversarialMatrix.hung_or_long_commands: IN: curl used max-time, uvicorn and Docker readiness were bounded, and all processes were stopped.
adversarialMatrix.flaky_tests: IN: concurrent quota tests passed three fresh repeats; deterministic transport sequences passed targeted and full suites.
adversarialMatrix.misleading_success_output: IN: HTTP status, typed bodies, exact recipe count, independent model-call/control state, Docker image ID, and cleanup receipts were inspected together.
adversarialMatrix.cancel_resume: PARTLY IN: server upload finally-close tests remained green. Client cancellation/resume and background re-upload are T5-owned; the T3 validation retry remains request-local and bounded.
adversarialMatrix.repeated_interruptions: OUT by design: T3 has no resumable job. Independent HTTP requests reset state; only validation failures retry and unrelated failures stop after one call.

residualRisks: Live Firestore contention remains T11-owned; this review inspected the transactional implementation and reran atomic fake concurrency stress.
Starlette parses multipart data into UploadFile before the endpoint's 8 MiB read ceiling, so a separate ingress-level temporary-spool cap may still be warranted during hardening.
backend/app/main.py remains in the programming skill's 200-250 pure-LOC warning band; it was unchanged by the fix.
